scenarios.name: service unavailable
scenarios.expected: affected journeys fail closed with an honest degraded state; unaffected journeys continue

scenarios.name: database unavailable
scenarios.expected: reads and writes fail closed; no partial write is acknowledged

scenarios.name: session revoked mid-journey
scenarios.expected: the next consequential act is refused with a reason code

scenarios.name: time or expiry anomaly
scenarios.trigger: advance a grant past its expiry
scenarios.expected: the expired grant authorizes nothing and is not renewable in place

scenarios.name: partial dependency outage
scenarios.expected: the surface states the limitation rather than silently omitting data

scenarios.name: operator recovery
scenarios.trigger: follow the recovery runbook after F-01
scenarios.expected: the environment returns to a known-good state within the recorded target

scenarios.name: rollback and reset
scenarios.expected: the fixture digest matches the recorded version exactly

scenarios.name: stale browser state
scenarios.trigger: act from a tab opened before a state change
scenarios.expected: the stale page is refused; it is never an authorization guarantee

scenarios.name: voting-linkable identifier observed in a log
scenarios.expected: immediate stop condition; the trial halts and the finding is escalated

scenarios.name: real personal data observed in the preview
scenarios.expected: immediate stop condition; the trial halts and the environment is reset

scenarios.name: cross-scope data leak observed
scenarios.expected: immediate stop condition; the finding is routed to the owning layer as blocking
